reviewer_scope: User-authorized independent AI publication assessment; no human, institutional or external signed X01 acceptance.
required_decision_evidence: Actual reviewer identity, model and independence/limitations disclosure
Exact reader and sponsor PDF hashes
Explicit reading coverage and primary-source checks; inherited evidence distinguished
Actual page-specific visual observations within the fresh session allowance
Reasoned accept/revise/reject recommendation and bounded scope
All blocking findings resolved or an explicit revise/reject disposition
No substantive content removed without destinations and post-execution audit
author_control_obligations: Preserve original independent report, including negative findings
Renew affected context/build/deletion/package proofs for every manuscript change
Keep protected historical controls and frozen release evidence unchanged
Do not classify disclosed research limits or bank-validation absence as automatic scholarly blockers
Do not call six visual samples whole-book inspection
